repositories.name: Babel Truth
repositories.notes: Owns transferable foundations, shared operating rules, semantic contracts, registry, and major architecture decisions. ADR 0004 names the frozen FIRE G7 runtime as the canonical implementation reference for same-role generic Babel shell behavior without creating a universal runtime component dependency. ADR 0006 permits bounded Lab incubation for unproven owning-product interaction behavior while preserving app ownership.

repositories.name: Babel FIRE
repositories.notes: Owns FIRE production runtime, frozen successor shell, FIRE-specific doctrine/specs/data/tests and promoted implementation. V6 remains production. G7 is 10/10 Locked and Frozen; approved shell runtime anchor is 4a258c5170dd1d96dcbc0f2b0a9c35b283cec489. FIRE remains the sole product authority even when bounded unproven FIRE Core interaction slices are auditioned in Babel Lab.

repositories.name: Babel Lab
repositories.notes: Lab is evidence, never authority. Experiments remain isolated from production runtime/data. Lab consumes the frozen Babel shell reference for generic UI roles, hosts a separate living Shell Gallery for shared-UI candidates, and may host clearly bounded owning-product auditions such as FIRE Core under fake/local state. Product doctrine/canonical behavior/runtime/data remain with the owning app. WORLD Phase 1 remains a bounded Lab audition and does not yet justify a standalone WORLD repository.

repositories.name: Babel World
repositories.notes: WORLD Phase 1 currently lives under babel-lab/world/context-loop/. A real WORLD product earns its own repo only after the bounded orientation/decision slice proves independent value through physical use.
